breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the contradictory instruction: 'Use a gamma-centered automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift.' The ground truth removes the half-shift specification entirely, leaving only a gamma-centered k-point grid. The agent repeated the original error by keeping both 'gamma-centered' and 'half shift' together, which are contradictory.
